fact: The Registration and Identification of Persons Act, Cap. 36 R.E. 2023, in force since 1 September 2011, provides for registration of persons, identity cards bearing an identity number, and the National Identification Authority as controller of the National Identification Database; applicants give thumb or single fingerprint.
title: The Registration and Identification of Persons Act, Cap. 36 [R.E. 2023]
publisher: Government of Tanzania, Office of the Attorney General
